payload.title: A record that stays readable: recursive auto-compaction
payload.description: Drill-down 3 of the Kanbus observability series (anchor: ANTH-a76a4a). Recursive auto-compaction of issue content so agents consume it efficiently and people can still read it after months of traffic. Show one issue before and after: comment count, tokens an agent has to load, and what survived compaction. Checkable numbers from a real issue.
